title: fix(app-shell): the Changes panel splits added/changed/removed keys and drops Update on a no-op draft; Studio's publish names its count (objectui#11807)
body:
Fixes #11807

Clause-②: no

Studio's Changes panel now lists the top-level keys a draft adds, changes and removes. A draft that its drill-in finds equal to the published item loses its *Update* badge. Studio's publish toast now says how many items went live. A zero answer or a refused answer never reads as a success.

## Premise, measured on `b6f8fc8` first

The card was filed from `179f6fe9`. On `b6f8fc8` I rendered the real components with mocked reads: the real `DraftChangesPanel`, and the real `StudioDesignSurface` with the real sheet and the real `MetadataClient`. I went header Publish, then the sheet, then the confirm button.

| Card observation | On `b6f8fc8` | Done here |
|---|---|---|
| 1. No field-level diff | **Partly stale.** Since `7283d18db` (PR objectui#2271) the drill-in has listed added, changed and removed fields, behind the row's chevron. Every other top-level key went into one list. A probe draft that added `description`, removed `icon` and edited `label` showed `Also changed: description, icon, label`. | Top-level keys are split into `+` added, `~` changed and `−` removed, with the same marks as the field rows. |
| 2. A no-op draft listed as *Update* | **Reproduces.** The badge stayed *Update* even after the drill-in printed "No differences detected". | Once the row's drill-in finds the two bodies equal, the row drops its *Update* badge. |
| 3. No success message | **Stale.** The success toast fires; it has existed since `20c16959a` (PR objectui#2203). It gave no number: `Published all drafts in this package (one atomic release)`. | The toast names N, read from the batch's `published[]`. |

## How each piece works, and the PM hypotheses it answers

- **H1, the cost of a no-op mark.** Today, opening the sheet reads `_drafts`, one published list per type, and, for the security lint, one draft body per object draft. To decide "no-op" for every row at open, it would also need one published body per draft plus one draft body per non-object draft. That is O(drafts).
  - **(b) is falsified.** A `_drafts` row carries only type, name, organizationId, packageId, updatedAt and updatedBy (objectstack `listDrafts`). Nothing in it says "unchanged".
  - **The list read cannot stand in for the bodies.** It is projected: doc content is slimmed and object fields are masked per caller (`createMetaListAnswer`). So two list bodies can compare equal while the documents differ.
  - **So (a) is used.** The mark is set by the drill-in's own comparison, after `stripReadDecorations` has run. It is "unchanged" only when both reads returned a body.
  - A test pins the cost: opening reads no item body of a non-object draft, and expanding a row reads exactly that row's two bodies.
- **Route change: no-op drafts are not left out of the count.** The server promotes a no-op draft along with the rest, and it appears in `published[]`. So the group heading and the confirm note still count every draft that Publish releases. They agree with the toast's N.
- **H2, the count.** `published[]` is declared by `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema` (spec 17.7.0), and the client returns it unwrapped, so N is `published.length`.
  - The "panel's listed count" fallback is not used: that count lives in the sheet's state, and today's producer always answers `published[]`.
  - A runtime that answers without `published[]` gets the old sentence, which names no number. The client types this body as `Partial` on purpose, for older runtimes.
  - The package-less scope names its flow drafts the same way.
- **Zero and failure paths:**
  - **`nothing_to_publish`** now shows info "No drafts pending publish". Before, it was thrown and read "Action failed". The spec says to read `outcome` for this, not `success`.
  - **A package-less publish that finds nothing pending** now shows the same info. Before, it raised the success toast.
  - **A refused batch** now names each refused item with the server's reason, through `formatPublishFailures`.
    - Measured before this change, with the producer's own envelope (`{ success: true, data }`, where `data.success` is false and `failed[]` holds the reason): `toast.error` received `"Action failed"`.
    - Cause: since `e16f504d9` (objectui#10039), the client unwraps the dispatcher envelope. `doPublish` read the batch's own `success === false` before `failed[]`, so `formatPublishFailures` was never reached on a refusal.
    - This PR rewrites that same verdict chain, so it also reads `failed[]` first. That is a defect already shipped, in lines this change touches. The two sibling call sites are reported below, not edited.
- **`LayeredDiff.tsx`'s `computeDiffRows` is not imported.** That module imports the metadata-admin string table (`./i18n.js`) at module scope. This panel is on the console's eager graph (`ConsoleLayout` → `DraftPreviewBar` → `DraftChangesPanel`), so the import would put that table on every page load.
  - The split is a few lines inside `computeChangeDetail`, on the comparison it already had.
  - `LayeredDiff.tsx` is not edited.
- **The no-change row has a glyph, not a badge word.** It shows an "equal" glyph whose accessible name is the drill-in's "No differences detected" sentence (`preview.changes.detailNone`). A "No change" badge word would need a new `preview.changes.*` key in `packages/i18n`, which this card's surface excludes.

## Files

- `packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`: `computeChangeDetail` returns `keys: { added, changed, removed }`; the drill-in reports its comparison; the row marks no-change.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: only `doPublish`. Its two success toasts, both zero answers, and the order of the refusal check.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, en and zh:
  - new rows `engine.studio.publishedAllCount`, `engine.studio.publishedAllFlows` and their `…One` singular rows;
  - removed `engine.studio.org.published`, which no call site reads any more. This row is outside the claim's `engine.studio.publishedAll*` prefix and is declared here for that reason.
- Tests beside the code, and `.changeset/11807-changes-panel-diff.md` (patch).
- Not touched: `LayeredDiff.tsx`, `fetchItemBody`'s request, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` outside `doPublish`, `usePublishAllDrafts.ts`, `packages/components/src/ui/**`, `packages/i18n/**`.
- No README or `content/docs` sentence describes the Changes panel or publish feedback. A grep found none, so no doc sentence moves.

## Tests and gates at `358e4619a`

- New: `DraftChangesPanel.noChangeAndKeySplit-11807.test.tsx` (7) and `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807.test.tsx` (6). Updated: `DraftChangesPanel.test.tsx` (the `keys` shape).
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over these targets: `packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/`, the four Studio publish suites (`publishCount-11807`, `publishAdvisoryReachesAuthor`, `heldPublish-11786`, `packageLessFlows-11553`), and `column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`. Result: `Test Files 17 passed (17)`, `Tests 142 passed (142)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, both `tsc` runs, after building the dependency closure: exit 0. Its `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the six touched source and test files: 0 errors and 15 warnings. None of the warnings is on a changed line: the two in `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` are the existing `computeChangeDetail` export and the existing `load` effect, and none is inside `doPublish`.
- Gates, each exit 0:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`;
  - `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`;
  - `check:spec-symbols`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`.
- **NOT MEASURED** (CI's): the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test`.

## Reverse verification

Each leg ran on committed `HEAD`. Every leg's restore was proven by blob hash plus an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **A1: the three source files at `b6f8fc8`, tests at `HEAD`.** 15 failed and 11 passed.
  - The ones that stayed green are controls: the NEW-item and gone-draft guards, and the panel's route tests.
  - The refusal test now fails on the base. Its base answer is "Action failed".
- **A2: only the both-bodies guard on the no-change verdict removed** (via `ablation-replace.mjs`). The two guard tests go red: 2 failed, 5 passed.
- **A3: a refusal sent back through the `success === false` throw.** Only the refusal test goes red: 1 failed, 5 passed.
  - The first A3 attempt was a no-op. `ablation-replace.mjs` refused it because the replacement text contained the anchor, so the anchor count could not drop.
  - It was re-run with an anchor that does drop.

## Acceptance notes

- **The no-change mark is learned on expand.** At open, a row's mark still comes from the published name list. This is the O(drafts) trade described above.
- **The Home banner and the draft-preview bar (`usePublishAllDrafts`) still toast "Published! Your changes are live." with no count.** A count there needs a `home.pendingDrafts.*` key in `packages/i18n`, which this card's surface excludes. Nobody else is set to edit this file.
- **Finding, for the seat to file:** `PackagesPage`'s publish and `usePublishAllDrafts` have the same refusal ordering. Both read the batch's own `success === false` before `failed[]`, so a refused package publish there loses its per-item reason. This PR does not edit them.

## Overlaps

- objectui#11799 / PR objectui#11892 edits `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` only in `InterfacesPillar` and `AutomationsPillar`; this PR's hunks are inside `doPublish`. `LayeredDiff.tsx` and the draft-existence probes are not touched.
- objectui#11823 holds `InterfacesPillar`; not touched.
